summary: One-frame event (client and server) raised by navcloud::RegionSystem when a navcloud region finished loading; holds the region coordinates (Vector3i<int>, the key type of navcloud::RegionDataComponent's map). Read by the obstacle processing (ProcessObstacle).

fields.name: RegionX
fields.evidence: creator bg3.exe+0x3928D10 (alloc 0xC) zeroes 8+4 bytes; macOS navcloud::RegionSystem::Update allocates 0xC and zeroes it the same way. 12 bytes = Vector3i<int> region key (navcloud::RegionDataComponent keys, stride 0xC). Live small positive ints 0..0xD, same values as navcloud::RegionLoadingComponent +0

fields.name: RegionY
fields.evidence: second int of the region key; live 0..4 and -1

fields.name: RegionZ
fields.evidence: third int of the region key; live negative (-0x40 .. -0x4C) and small positives

open_questions: axis order of the three ints (x,y,z vs x,z,y) not checked
